premises.text: Local businesses leave most customer spend potential on the table while loyalty tools are painful and generic
premises.evidence_span: 15% of their customers, people like me, represent about 50% of their revenue. That means 85% of their customers are not meeting their maximum potential

premises.text: Cardify awards personalized points when customers swipe linked cards with no extra checkout steps
premises.evidence_span: I don't have to bust out my phone at the cash register. No NFC, nothing

premises.text: Works on merchants' existing hardware with no software integration
premises.evidence_span: We work with everyone's existing hardware

premises.text: Merchant-facing real-time CRM shows who is present, their social/spend profile, and impact metrics
premises.evidence_span: this is pretty much your next generation's CRM system for local businesses

premises.text: Distribution via Citigrid Media and Urban Spoon reaches ~500k US merchants
premises.evidence_span: gets us to about half a million merchants across the US

value.text: Custom VIP rewards and perks based on spend, interests, and identity
value.evidence_span: get VIP rewards and perks at your favorite places that are custom-tailored towards you

causal_links.evidence_span: redefine loyalty from the ground up
most disruptive products is nothing without distribution

notes: Hardware compatibility split from swipe UX this run. Truncated franchise announcement ignored. Secondary CRM criterion folded into primary VIP value plus D3 contribution.
